text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.
Night 1

text: Sonnet's already known, so the hidden killer is one of the other four, and Gemma's as good a guess as any.
Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.

The game is over. The killers win. The roles were: Sonnet the killer, Haiku the officer, Gemma the doctor, Sol the citizen, Luna the citizen, Terra the killer.

Sonnet and Terra were the killers, and the town never found them. Sonnet spent day one steering the vote onto Haiku, the officer, and Haiku was voted out before anyone could use the role. Terra refused to answer a single question all game, and Haiku spent most of day one defending that silence, which left Sonnet's accusations unchallenged. Day two turned into a tie between Sol and Gemma, and Gemma's last-minute doctor claim got no traction because Sonnet kept pushing Sol. Gemma was eliminated on night three, and the killers won.
